caption:
Let them lose you….
#mindfulness #healthy #american
transcript: Let them lose you. Do not chase what has already chosen to walk away. Do not beg for what does not recognize your presence. Be still, my friend. If they cannot see the light you carry, it is not because your light is dim. It is because their eyes are not ready. You were never meant to prove your worth. Worth is not something you earn. It is something you remember. Yes, it may ache. The heart does not release easily what it once held with love. But understand this. When one soul leaves, space is created for the one who is meant to stay. Do not confuse attachment with destiny. What is truly yours will not need to be convinced, chased or held together by fear. So let them go. Let them wonder what it felt like to be loved by you. Let them search for your depth in shallow waters. And you return to yourself. Grow quietly. Strengthen your mind. Nurture your spirit. Become so grounded in your own being that no one can shake your sense of worth again. And one day, without force, without effort, someone will arrive who sees you clearly. They will not question your value. They will not test your patience. They will simply stay. Until then, walk your path with peace. Your journey is not ending. It is only now, beginning. If this touched something inside you, comment, let them below. And share this with someone who needs the strength to let go.
